directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for concrete pump inquiry product url. The row to open is /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. The site configuration lists PinjinHebei@Outlook.com and 19912003025, plus the contact page and the on-site WhatsApp button. The section title “Vertical U-Tube Manometer” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
